newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures higher on yen's dip.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures higher on yen's dip.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Tuesday, supported by the yen's further dip against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.7 yen to 4.1 yen per kg higher. Benchmark April was 3.5 yen higher at 143.3 yen.
The market started on a firmer note, and the yen's further weakness encouraged fresh buying by private investors.
"The weak yen and the firmer spot expiry last Friday helped shore up prices. The market was focusing on whether the dollar will break above 115 yen soon," one trader said.
